description:
Use this when the user asks which Indian companies report results soon, optionally by sector. For a past window or other event types use get_market_calendar.

Returns companies with a board meeting for results in the next `days` days (1 to 90, default 14), earliest first, with the date and identifiers. `sector` filters to one sector; a name that is not recognised returns the closest valid names, and companies DalalOS has not matched to a sector are left out. `limit` is 1 to 200 (default 50); `truncated` says when later dates were cut. For past dates or other kinds of event use get_market_calendar.
name: get_upcoming_results
title: Upcoming results
